::: {.eyebrow}
Protists
:::

::: {.lead}
The word "protist" is a catch-all for incredibly diverse single-celled
eukaryotes. There are protists related to plants, protists related to fungi,
protists related to animals, and protists that form their own distinct lineages.
:::

---

::: {.eyebrow}
What we study
:::

::: {.question}
### Symbiosis

How do cells from different branches of life interact? What molecules are
exchanged? What mediates their interactions?
:::

::: {.question}
### Biomineralization

How does life concentrate elements to seed and control mineral formation? What
is the function of the complex forms created?
:::

::: {.question}
### Evolution

How can studying diversity inform us of the link between information (DNA
sequence) and form and function (phenotype)?
:::
